name: Wako Kosan Co., Ltd. (有限会社和幸興産)
note: Unlisted real-estate management company in Kashiwa, Chiba; parent of Sankyo Frontier. Sankyo Frontier's securities report for the year ended March 2026 says its voting rights are 100% held by 長妻和男, 長妻貴嗣 and their close relatives. English name from its own EDINET filing (2021-05-12: 'Wako Kosan Co,.Ltd.').
